sections.label: mistral large 4
sections.chapter: Mistral Large 4 is now open weight

It's a one trillion parameter model that Mistral nicknames Le Chonk.
It's on Hugging Face now, under a modified MIT license.
Mistral says it scores forty one percent on Terminal-Bench four.

On Mistral's API, it costs seventy cents per million input tokens.
Output is two dollars ten per million.
